task.question: Who was dismissed as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine on 21 July 2026?
task.evidence: 21 July – President Zelenskyy dismisses Oleksandr Syrskyi as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, replacing him with Mykhailo Drapatyi amidst protests demanding Syrskyi’s removal.

answer:
On July 21, 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky dismissed Oleksandr Syrsky from his position as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. He appointed Major General Mykhailo Drapaty as the new commander. This change followed public pressure stemming from the recent dismissal of the country's defense minister. 

FINAL: Oleksandr Syrsky was dismissed as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
